newsitem.title: FRANCE: Traders target EU wheat export refund of 18.5 Ecus.
newsitem.headline: Traders target EU wheat export refund of 18.5 Ecus.

text.p: Grain exporters on Thursday said they expected the European Union to grant a refund of some 18.5 Ecus per tonne on soft wheat exports at this week's tender.
Based on bids, this would clear the release of up to 244,000 tonnes of wheat in France, plus any additional exports granted elsewhere in the European Union, they said.
In France grain traders bid to export 658,000 tonnes of EU soft wheat at refunds ranging from 17.69 to 21.24 Ecus a tonne.
Last week the European Union granted the export of 211,350 tonnes of soft wheat at a refund of 18.99 Ecus per tonne.
Exporters said the large tonnage sought this week was linked to the recent sale of 500,000 tonnes of French wheat to Egypt.
The lowest bid for a wheat subsidy placed in France was for the export of 2,500 tonnes of soft wheat, exporters said,

Other cumulative offers included bids to export up to 114,000 tonnes of wheat at a refund of 18.00 Ecus, up to 244,000 tonnes at 18.50, 315,000 tonnes at 18.75, 536,000 tonnes at 19.00 Ecus and up to 658,000 tonnes at 21.24 Ecus.
